description: This file defines a class 'BearerTokenAuthorization' that implements token-based authorization by adding Bearer tokens to HTTP requests, used within AWS SDK's token handling for authorization.

classes.name: BearerTokenAuthorization
classes.description: Provides a strategy to add Bearer token authorization headers to HTTP requests within AWS SDK.

methods.name: authorizeRequest
methods.description: Adds the Bearer token to the request header, throwing an exception if the token is empty.
